say:1:1730301301:1.text: They can't let their resentments show, right?
say:1:1730301301:1.source_cn: 你也说了两人关系是看起来不错。
say:1:1730301301:1.male: They can't let their resentments show, right?
say:1:1730301301:1.female: They can't let their resentments show, right?

say:2:1730301302:1.text: After all, Prince Orion is only her stepson, and the Queen still has her own daughter...
say:2:1730301302:1.source_cn: 可奥利安王子毕竟不是亲生，而王后可还有亲生的佩吉殿下……
say:2:1730301302:1.male: After all, Prince Orion is only her stepson, and the Queen still has her own daughter...
say:2:1730301302:1.female: After all, Prince Orion is only her stepson, and the Queen still has her own daughter...

say:3:1730301303:1.text: In fact, it's impressive how they've managed to keep up appearances all this time.
say:3:1730301303:1.source_cn: 能够维持表面得体，已经是他们两人共同努力的结果。
say:3:1730301303:1.male: In fact, it's impressive how they've managed to keep up appearances all this time.
say:3:1730301303:1.female: In fact, it's impressive how they've managed to keep up appearances all this time.
